result.brief: 提出对视觉动力学预测进行机械一致性（几何、力、能量）审计与诊断的评测框架，并用于评估 V-JEPA 等视频世界模型。
result.reason: Introduces a benchmark/diagnostic framework auditing mechanical consistency of visual dynamics predictors, evaluating V-JEPA and video world models; contributes evaluation methodology for video dynamics prediction.
